# Story 5.3: All actions go through a governed Action Engine

**Story ID:** 5.3  
**Epic:** 5 - Runtime Architecture - Reasoning/Action Separation  
**Status:** done  
**Created:** 2026-01-06

## User Story

**As a** system,
**I want** all actions to go through a governed Action Engine,
**So that** each action is validated and controlled before execution..

## Acceptance Criteria

**Given** an intention is generated by the LLM
**When** the intention is processed
**Then** the intention is sent to the Action Engine
**And** the Action Engine validates the intention against the policies
**And** the Action Engine executes the action only if validated
**And** all actions are tracked after execution

## Business Value

- **Functionality**: Feature implemented
- **Quality**: Tested and validated
- **Traceability**: Events tracked
